title: Duct stream (streams/<name>.yaml)
description: One Kafka topic landed in a Bronze table by `duct stream` (and followed by `duct alerts` when it has a window). Brokers come from [kafka] in duct.toml.

name.description: Unique stream name; also the default table name and the name of the alerts window table.

topic.description: Kafka topic carrying one JSON object per message.

target.description: Destination table, always in bronze. Default: bronze.<name>.

batch.description: A micro-batch is written when max_rows messages are buffered or max_interval has passed since the first one.

start.description: Where a group with no committed offset begins.

inline_rows.description: DuckLake data_inlining_row_limit for the bronze schema: micro-batches up to this many rows go to the catalog instead of a Parquet file each (`duct gc` flushes them).

window.description: How much history `duct alerts` keeps in memory for this stream (Go duration, e.g. 10m). Omitted: alerts ignore the stream.
